roles_description_length.name: roles_description_length

working_copies_subject.name: working_copies_subject
working_copies_subject.value: ("working_copies"."subject_type" = 'module' and "working_copies"."subject_id" ~ '^[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})*/[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$') or ("working_copies"."subject_type" = 'manual' and "working_copies"."subject_id" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$') or ("working_copies"."subject_type" = 'config' and "working_copies"."subject_id" = 'ccms.yaml') or ("working_copies"."subject_type" = 'term' and "working_copies"."subject_id" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$')

refresh_conflicts_subject.name: refresh_conflicts_subject

asset_uploads_file_name.name: asset_uploads_file_name
asset_uploads_file_name.value: "asset_uploads"."file_name" is null or char_length("asset_uploads"."file_name") between 1 and 255

comments_body.name: comments_body
comments_body.value: ("comments"."deleted_at" is null and "comments"."body" is not null and char_length("comments"."body") between 1 and 10000) or ("comments"."deleted_at" is not null and "comments"."body" is null and "comments"."thread_id" = "comments"."id")

comments_resolution.name: comments_resolution
comments_resolution.value: ("comments"."resolved_at" is null and "comments"."resolved_by_kind" is null and "comments"."resolved_by_id" is null) or ("comments"."resolved_at" is not null and "comments"."resolved_by_kind" is not null and "comments"."resolved_by_id" is not null and "comments"."resolved_by_kind" in ('user', 'service') and char_length("comments"."resolved_by_id") between 1 and 200 and "comments"."thread_id" = "comments"."id")

release_outputs_audience.name: release_outputs_audience
release_outputs_audience.value: "release_outputs"."audience" is null or char_length("release_outputs"."audience") between 1 and 64

release_outputs_file.name: release_outputs_file
release_outputs_file.value: ("release_outputs"."state" = 'done') = ("release_outputs"."sha256" is not null and "release_outputs"."size" is not null)

release_outputs_error.name: release_outputs_error
release_outputs_error.value: ("release_outputs"."error_code" is null) = ("release_outputs"."error_detail" is null) and ("release_outputs"."error_detail" is null or char_length("release_outputs"."error_detail") <= 1000) and ("release_outputs"."error_code" is null or char_length("release_outputs"."error_code") between 1 and 100)

releases_revision.name: releases_revision
releases_revision.value: "releases"."revision" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,99}$' and "releases"."revision" not like '%..%' and "releases"."revision" not like '%.' and "releases"."revision" not like '%.lock'

releases_notes.name: releases_notes
releases_notes.value: "releases"."notes" is null or char_length("releases"."notes") between 1 and 10000

maintenance_lines_closed.name: maintenance_lines_closed
maintenance_lines_closed.value: ("maintenance_lines"."closed_at" is null and "maintenance_lines"."closed_by_kind" is null and "maintenance_lines"."closed_by_id" is null) or ("maintenance_lines"."closed_at" is not null and "maintenance_lines"."closed_by_kind" in ('user', 'service') and char_length("maintenance_lines"."closed_by_id") between 1 and 200)

module_index_modules_readable.name: module_index_modules_readable
module_index_modules_readable.value: ("module_index_modules"."error" is null) = ("module_index_modules"."title" is not null and "module_index_modules"."module_type" is not null and "module_index_modules"."facets" is not null)

imports_base_ref.name: imports_base_ref
imports_base_ref.value: char_length("imports"."base_ref") between 1 and 256 and "imports"."base_ref" not like 'change-sets/%'

webhooks_secrets.name: webhooks_secrets
webhooks_secrets.value: char_length("webhooks"."secret_sealed") between 1 and 1000 and ("webhooks"."previous_secret_sealed" is null) = ("webhooks"."previous_secret_until" is null)

webhooks_disabled.name: webhooks_disabled
webhooks_disabled.value: ("webhooks"."disabled_reason" is null or "webhooks"."disabled_reason" = 'failing') and ("webhooks"."disabled_reason" is null or not "webhooks"."active") and ("webhooks"."disabled_reason" is null) = ("webhooks"."disabled_at" is null)

storage_usage_counts.name: storage_usage_counts
storage_usage_counts.value: "storage_usage"."media_bytes" >= 0 and "storage_usage"."media_files" >= 0 and "storage_usage"."pdf_bytes" >= 0 and "storage_usage"."pdf_files" >= 0 and "storage_usage"."media_added_bytes" >= 0 and "storage_usage"."media_added_files" >= 0 and "storage_usage"."pdf_added_bytes" >= 0 and "storage_usage"."pdf_added_files" >= 0

storage_usage_sizes.name: storage_usage_sizes
storage_usage_sizes.value: ("storage_usage"."git_bytes" is null or "storage_usage"."git_bytes" >= 0) and ("storage_usage"."database_bytes" is null or "storage_usage"."database_bytes" >= 0)
